rewind.confirmMessage: Rewind to this point? Later messages in the current conversation will be discarded, this prompt will be restored to the input box, and file changes will be restored when possible. Rewinding does not affect files edited manually or via bash.
rewind.notice: Rewound the conversation and restored {count} file(s). The prompt is ready to edit.
rewind.noticeSaveFailed: Rewound the conversation (restored {count} file(s)), but failed to save state: {error}
rewind.noticeConversationOnly: Rewound the conversation. No file changes needed restoring, and the prompt is ready to edit.
rewind.noticePartial: Rewound the conversation and restored {count} file(s), but some later changes could not be restored safely.

fork.unavailableNoResponse: Cannot fork: no response to fork from
fork.commandNoMessages: Cannot fork: no messages in conversation
fork.commandNoAssistantUuid: Cannot fork: no assistant response with identifiers

userName.name: What should Codex CLI call you?
userName.desc: Your name for personalized greetings (leave empty for generic greetings)

excludedTags.name: Excluded tags
excludedTags.desc: Notes with these tags will not auto-load as context (one per line, without #)

mediaFolder.name: Media folder
mediaFolder.desc: Folder containing attachments/images. When notes use ![[image.jpg]], Codex will look here. Leave empty for vault root.

systemPrompt.name: Custom system prompt
systemPrompt.desc: Additional instructions appended to the default system prompt

autoTitle.name: Auto-generate conversation titles
autoTitle.desc: Automatically generate conversation titles after the first user message is sent.

titleModel.name: Title generation model
titleModel.desc: Model used for auto-generating conversation titles.

navMappings.name: Vim-style navigation mappings
navMappings.desc: One mapping per line. Format: "map <key> <action>" (actions: scrollUp, scrollDown, focusInput).

slashCommands.name: Commands and Skills
slashCommands.desc: Define custom commands and skills triggered by /name.

hiddenSlashCommands.name: Hidden Commands
hiddenSlashCommands.desc: Hide specific slash commands from the dropdown. Useful for hiding commands that are not relevant to this Codex-powered workflow. Enter command names without the leading slash, one per line.

mcpServers.name: MCP Servers
mcpServers.desc: Configure Model Context Protocol servers to extend Codex with external tools and data sources. Servers with context-saving mode require @mention to activate.

plugins.name: Legacy Plugins
plugins.desc: Legacy Codex CLI plugins are not supported in the Codex-only runtime.

subagents.name: Subagents
subagents.desc: Configure custom subagents that Codex can delegate to.
subagents.noAgents: No subagents configured. Click + to create one.
subagents.renameCleanupFailed: Warning: could not remove old file for "{name}"

modal.name: Name
modal.nameDesc: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only
modal.descriptionPlaceholder: Reviews code for bugs and style
modal.toolsDesc: Comma-separated list of allowed tools (empty = all)
modal.disallowedToolsDesc: Comma-separated list of tools to disallow
modal.promptPlaceholder: You are a code reviewer. Analyze the given code for...

loadUserSettings.name: Load legacy user settings
loadUserSettings.desc: Legacy Codex user settings import is not used by the Codex-only runtime.

allowExternalAccess.name: Allow external access
allowExternalAccess.desc: Allow file and command access outside the vault directory. Takes effect immediately for all active sessions. Disabling vault restriction may expose sensitive files to prompt injection.

blockedCommands.name: Blocked commands ({platform})
blockedCommands.desc: Patterns to block on {platform} (one per line). Supports regex.
blockedCommands.unixDesc: Unix patterns also blocked on Windows because Git Bash can invoke them.

exportPaths.name: Allowed export paths
exportPaths.desc: Write-only destinations outside the vault when external access is off (one per line). Supports ~ for home directory.
exportPaths.disabledDesc: Ignored while external access is enabled. Turn off external access to enforce write-only export paths.

customVariables.name: Custom variables
customVariables.desc: Environment variables for Codex CLI and related tooling (KEY=VALUE format, one per line). Shell export prefix supported. Authentication is managed outside the plugin via `codex login`.

envSnippets.name: Snippets
envSnippets.noSnippets: No saved environment snippets yet. Click + to save your current environment configuration.
envSnippets.nameRequired: Please enter a name for the snippet

modal.name: Name
modal.namePlaceholder: A descriptive name for this environment configuration
modal.envVarsPlaceholder: KEY=VALUE format, one per line (export prefix supported)

customContextLimits.name: Custom Context Limits
customContextLimits.desc: Set context window sizes for your custom models. Leave empty to use the default (200k tokens).
customContextLimits.invalid: Invalid format. Use: 256k, 1m, or exact count (1000-10000000).

enableOpus1M.name: Opus 1M context window
enableOpus1M.desc: Show Opus 1M in the model selector. Included with Max, Team, and Enterprise plans. API and Pro users need extra usage.

enableSonnet1M.name: Sonnet 1M context window
enableSonnet1M.desc: Show Sonnet 1M in the model selector. Requires extra usage on Max, Team, and Enterprise plans. API and Pro users need extra usage.

enableChrome.name: Enable Chrome extension
enableChrome.desc: Legacy Chrome extension integration is not supported in the Codex-only runtime.

enableBangBash.name: Enable bash mode (!)
enableBangBash.desc: Type ! on empty input to enter bash mode. Runs commands directly via Node.js child_process. Requires view reopen.

validation.noNode: Node.js not found on PATH. Install Node.js or check your PATH configuration.

maxTabs.name: Maximum chat tabs
maxTabs.desc: Maximum number of concurrent chat tabs (3-10). Each tab uses a separate Codex session.
maxTabs.warning: More than 5 tabs may impact performance and memory usage.

tabBarPosition.name: Tab bar position
tabBarPosition.desc: Choose where to display tab badges and action buttons

enableAutoScroll.name: Auto-scroll during streaming
enableAutoScroll.desc: Automatically scroll to the bottom as Codex streams responses. Disable to stay at the top and read from the beginning.

openInMainTab.name: Open in main editor area
openInMainTab.desc: Open chat panel as a main tab in the center editor area instead of the right sidebar

acpPath.name: codex-acp path
acpPath.desc: Custom path to the codex-acp adapter used for streaming chat. Leave empty for auto-detection.
acpPath.descWindows: Windows hosts are supported only through WSL2. Set the codex-acp path inside WSL.
acpPath.descUnix: Paste the output of "which codex-acp" if auto-detection fails.

cliPath.name: Codex CLI path
cliPath.desc: Custom path to the Codex CLI used for one-shot tasks such as title generation and inline edit. Leave empty for auto-detection.
cliPath.descWindows: Windows hosts are supported only through WSL2. Set the Codex path inside WSL.
cliPath.descUnix: Paste the output of "which codex" if auto-detection fails.

validation.isDirectory: Path is a directory, not a file

language.name: Language
language.desc: Change the display language of the plugin interface
